name: Nassau County, FL
findings: Nassau County has 296 nonprofit organizations. 102 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Nassau County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 33 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
